```{python}
#| include: false
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import plotnine_polars as p9
from plotnine_polars import aes
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from maketables import ETable
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
pl.Config.set_tbl_cols(200)
pl.Config.set_tbl_width_chars(120)
pl.Config.set_tbl_hide_dataframe_shape(True)
pl.Config.set_tbl_hide_column_data_types(True)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_e(rng, n=100_000):
    return rng.standard_normal(n)

def fit_ols(formula, data, subset=None):
    data = data.to_pandas()
    if subset is not None:
        subset = subset.to_numpy()
    return smf.ols(formula, data=data, subset=subset).fit()
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)

industry = get_e(rng)
intelligence = get_e(rng)
education = 3 * intelligence + 4 * industry + get_e(rng)
income = 10 + 5 * education + 6 * intelligence + 7 * industry + get_e(rng)

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "industry": industry,
    "intelligence": intelligence,
    "education": education,
    "income": income,
})

formulas = [
    "income ~ education",
    "income ~ education + intelligence + industry",
    "income ~ intelligence + industry",
]

fms = [fit_ols(f, data=df) for f in formulas]
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
ETable(
    fms,
    model_stats=["N", "r2"],
    coef_fmt="b:.3f \n (t:.3f)",
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_admissions_data(n, rng):
    test = get_e(rng, n)
    interview = get_e(rng, n)
    score = test + interview
    cutoff = np.quantile(score, 0.90)
    return pl.DataFrame({
        "test": test,
        "interview": interview,
        "score": score,
        "cutoff": cutoff,
        "admitted": score >= cutoff,
    })

rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)
admissions = get_admissions_data(100_000, rng)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
(
    admissions
    .ggplot(aes(x="test", y="interview", color="admitted"))
    .geom_point(alpha=0.6)
    .labs(x="Test Score", y="Interview Score", color="Admitted")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
specs = [
    ("interview ~ test", None),
    ("interview ~ test", ~admissions["admitted"]),
    ("interview ~ test", admissions["admitted"]),
    ("interview ~ test * admitted", None),
]

fms_collider = [
    fit_ols(formula, admissions, subset=subset)
    for formula, subset in specs
]
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
ETable(
    fms_collider,
    model_stats=["N", "r2"],
    coef_fmt="b:.3f* \n (t:.3f)",
    signif_code=[0.01, 0.05, 0.10],
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def get_disc_df(n, rng):
    female = rng.random(n) >= 0.5
    disc = female
    occ = 1 + 0 * female - 2 * disc + get_e(rng, n)
    salary = 1 - 1 * disc + 2 * occ + get_e(rng, n)
    return pl.DataFrame({
        "female": female,
        "discrimination": disc,
        "occupation": occ,
        "salary": salary,
    })

rng = np.random.default_rng(2023)
disc_df = get_disc_df(100_000, rng)

fms_discrim = [
    fit_ols("salary ~ female", disc_df),
    fit_ols("salary ~ female + occupation", disc_df),
]
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
ETable(
    fms_discrim,
    model_stats=["N", "r2"],
    coef_fmt="b:.3f* \n (t:.3f)",
    signif_code=[0.01, 0.05, 0.10],
)
```
